observations: All twenty single-finger views are readable and camera framing is suitable for direct before/after comparison.
Thumb intrinsic dorsal and palmar views follow the authored 60-degree roll, retaining its difference from the four long fingers.
Source thumb radial/ulnar views show conspicuous triangular normal discontinuities at the lower roll transition and near its tip.
All side silhouettes show angular DIP/PIP transitions; long nails look like applied plates in strict side views.
The source free-edge nail color band is broad and hard, and cuticle transition is absent or too subtle.
Source fingerprint loops appear widely spaced, regular and shallow; transverse dorsal creases lack the reference folds branching structure.
Lower corner glove open contours are actual extracted source polygons; no cap surfaces, image composites or anatomical additions were invented.
